nonclaims: A managed dispatch describes an exact call but does not invoke, authenticate, isolate, meter, or attest a provider, model, or subagent.
Invocation receipts are host declarations; they cannot prove that omitted calls did not occur or that model, timing, and failure metadata are honest.
Fixed heterogeneous routes preserve intended topology but do not prove worker independence, fresh context, or absence of shared memory.
Exact rollout beats prove supplied cardinality, not faithful simulation, useful diversity, search coverage, or predictive quality.
Provenance-blind judging does not prove semantic anonymity or calibrated preference measurement.
A verifier pass is advisory and cannot replace parent assembly, kernel review, commit, recovery, or presentation authority.
Managed checkpoint directories contain sensitive rejected futures and receive no bundled encryption, archival, redaction, expiry, or secure deletion guarantee.
Cooperative same-host locking is not a hostile-user, distributed-locking, or cross-filesystem transaction guarantee.
Revision 0160 makes the retcon experiment runnable and auditable but does not report a completed comparative experiment showing that it improves fiction or science.
